explanation: For the upper surface z=4-x²-y², the outward vector area element is ⟨2x,2y,1⟩ dA, so its flux integrand is 2y(4-x²-y²)-y. The bottom disk has outward normal ⟨0,0,-1⟩ and contributes y. Adding gives 8y-2x²y-2y³, option e. All displayed expressions integrate to zero over the symmetric disk D, but e directly represents the combined surface contributions.
